# U Scale by Mehul Karotra

> Freelance web design, development and digital marketing in Mumbai, India. U Scale is Mehul Karotra, a UI/UX developer-designer who designs and builds websites and runs SEO, social media, Google and Meta ads and AI search visibility for businesses, personally, on fixed-price contracts or monthly plans. An independent alternative to a digital marketing agency.

## Pricing (INR)

### Websites (one-time, fixed price)
- Landing page: ₹25,000
- Portfolio site: ₹40,000
- Business site, 3–4 pages: ₹55,000
- Business site, 5–10 pages + blog: ₹85,000
- E-commerce, under 50 products: ₹95,000
- E-commerce, 50–500 products: from ₹1,50,000
- Restaurant site + own online ordering: ₹90,000
- Redesign of your current site: 70% of a fresh build
- Care plan: updates, backups, security: ₹3,500/mo
- Copywriting (₹2,000/page), photography, premium plugins and payment gateway fees are quoted separately, always before I start.

### Monthly services (combine any)
- Local SEO / Google Business Profile: ₹15,000/mo
- Technical + on-page SEO: ₹25,000/mo
- AI search visibility (GEO): ₹12,000/mo
- Ads management: ₹20,000/mo (Flat up to ₹1.5L monthly ad spend, then 12% of spend. Setup ₹10,000 one-time; ad spend paid to Google/Meta directly.)
- Email marketing: ₹8,000/mo
- Review & reputation management: ₹10,000/mo
- WhatsApp automation: ₹8,000 setup (One-time setup; the WhatsApp platform is billed at cost.)
- Community & inbox management: ₹12,000/mo

### Unit prices
- Social design: Social post ₹800; Carousel ₹1,500; Designed story ₹800; Infographic ₹4,000
- Reel editing: Reel edit (your footage) ₹2,500; Premium edit (grading, motion graphics) ₹5,000
- Reel production: Half-day shoot + 3 reels ₹15,000; Full-day shoot + 6 reels ₹25,000
- Writing: SEO blog (~1,000 words) ₹2,000; Website copy ₹2,000/page; LinkedIn article ₹2,500
- Brand identity: Logo ₹5,000; Identity kit ₹20,000; Full identity system from ₹45,000
- Audits: SEO deep-dive audit (free if we work together) ₹7,500; AI visibility audit (free if we work together) ₹2,500

### Terms
- 20% advance to start, 20% on design sign-off, 60% on launch. Final files are released after the final payment.
- 2–3 revision rounds included on every project, agreed in writing before I start.
- Every website includes mobile-responsive design, enquiry forms, basic SEO, Google Maps, social links and a 15–30 day bug-fix window.
- Retainers: free audit first, a 3-month sprint, then month-to-month. 30 days notice to pause or cancel.
- Quotes are valid for 14 days.

## FAQ

- **Is U Scale an agency or a freelancer?** A bit of both, in the best way. U Scale is me, Mehul Karotra, working as an independent, contract-based partner. You get agency-quality design, development and marketing, but you sign with me directly and talk to me directly. If a project ever needs a specialist, like a photographer, I bring them in and stay your single point of contact.
- **How much does a website cost in Mumbai?** With me, a landing page is ₹25,000, a 3–4 page business site ₹55,000, a 5–10 page site with a blog ₹85,000, and e-commerce starts at ₹95,000. Every price is fixed and agreed in writing before I start. Every price is listed on the pricing page.
- **How much does digital marketing cost in Mumbai?** There are no bundles to squeeze into: you pay only for what you need. Local SEO is ₹15,000/month, technical SEO ₹25,000/month, ads management ₹20,000/month (plus a ₹10,000 setup), AI search visibility ₹12,000/month, and one-off work starts at ₹800 for a social post. The quote builder on the pricing page adds it up for you.
- **Do you work on contract or monthly retainer?** Both. Websites and branding are fixed-price contracts: 20% to start, 20% on design sign-off and 60% on launch. Marketing runs as a monthly retainer: a 3-month sprint, then month-to-month with 30 days notice. No long lock-ins.
- **How long does SEO take to show results?** Honest answer: 3–6 months for meaningful movement. Anyone promising page one in 30 days is selling you something. I show you the trajectory every month.
- **How long does it take to build a website?** A business website typically takes 4–8 weeks from kickoff to launch, depending on pages and how ready your content is. A landing page can be live in under two weeks.
- **What is AI search visibility (GEO)?** When someone asks ChatGPT or Perplexity for a recommendation in your category, does your business get mentioned? I optimise your presence so AI answers cite you.
- **How do we start?** Book a free strategy call or ping me on WhatsApp. I audit your digital presence for free, then send a plan with clear pricing.
